item_name: LANDING (FLAPS LDG - FLAPS UP - FLAPS Τ/Ο - ELP - AΟA)

observations.text: SP flew the landing to the standard set for this Training Section, with the IP calling the power reduction and taking the controls to complete the round out. Touchdown occurred 1900 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 20 feet left of the centerline and 13 knots above the computed touchdown speed, and the float that developed after the high flare was terminated by the IP. Marginal performance for the Training Section - independent timing of the round out and of the gradual power reduction is expected to develop over the following sorties.

SP completed the landing without the IP directing or executing any part of the sequence, requiring only verbal indications to start the gradual power reduction and to hold the landing attitude. Touchdown was achieved 1500 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 15 feet from the centerline and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The float that developed was recognized and corrected with delay, after the IP's verbal indication. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the round out in time, assumed the landing attitude and brought the A/C to touchdown without any verbal prompting from the IP. Touchdown occurred 1250 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 9 feet right of the centerline and 7 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The drift at touchdown was recognized by the SP and corrected in a timely manner without the IP's intervention, and the A/C was decelerated to taxi speed and vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP executed the round out promptly and accurately, reducing power gradually and assuming the landing attitude at the correct height. Touchdown was achieved 900 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 4 feet of the centerline and 3 knots above the computed touchdown speed, with no float, balloon or bounce. After touchdown the A/C was decelerated to taxi speed by the standard procedure, without abrupt oscillations, and vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the landing with exceptional precision, reducing power gradually and timing the round out so that the landing attitude was assumed with negligible deviation from the computed values. Touchdown was achieved 750 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and 1 knot above the computed touchdown speed, on the main wheels and with no drift. The crosswind controls were applied continuously through the deceleration and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP without any correction being required. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, due to a late and rapid round out, did not reduce power gradually or reduce the rate of descent in order to assume the landing attitude, and the A/C ballooned. SP could not bring the A/C to the touchdown point with the proper attitude without assistance, with the result that the IP took the controls and completed the landing 1850 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 22 feet right of the centerline. Touchdown speed was 12 knots above the computed value.

SP completed the landing to the standard set for this Training Section, initiating the gradual power reduction and holding the landing attitude after the IP's verbal indications. Touchdown was achieved at the limits for the code, 1500 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 15 feet left of the centerline and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed, and the float was recognized and corrected with delay. Marginal performance for the Training Section - an unprompted round out and a touchdown closer to the 1000 feet point are expected in the following sorties.

SP flew the round out in time and assumed the landing attitude without any verbal indication from the IP, directing the A/C to the RWY centerline throughout. Touchdown occurred 1300 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 8 feet from the centerline and 6 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The minor bounce that followed was recognized by the SP and corrected in a timely manner without the IP's intervention. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP executed the landing accurately and promptly, applying the gradual power reduction, reducing the rate of descent and assuming the landing attitude at the correct height. Touchdown was achieved 950 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 5 feet of the centerline and 4 knots above the computed touchdown speed, with the proper attitude and no drift. The A/C was decelerated to taxi speed by the standard procedure without abrupt oscillations and vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the landing with exceptional accuracy, with the round out timed so that the landing attitude was assumed without any float, balloon or bounce. Touchdown was achieved 800 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and with negligible deviation from the computed touchdown speed. Crosswind controls were applied progressively through the roll-out and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP without any deviation. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, due to an over-controlled aircraft (AE104) in the correction after the high flare, did not bring the A/C to touchdown with the proper attitude, and the A/C floated and then porpoised. SP did not recognize the porpoising or react accordingly, with the result that the IP took the controls and executed the go-around. On the following approach touchdown occurred 1750 feet from the beginning of the RWY and 18 feet from the centerline, under the IP's direction.

SP, due to an excessive power setting held into the flare, did not reduce the rate of descent in the way required to assume the landing attitude, and the A/C floated along the RWY. The float was recognized and corrected only after the IP's verbal indication, with the result that touchdown was achieved at the limit of 1500 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 15 feet left of the centerline and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed.

SP brought the A/C to touchdown with the proper attitude and within the standards set for this Training Section, correcting a minor balloon after the round out without the IP's intervention. Touchdown occurred 1400 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 12 feet from the centerline and 8 knots above the computed touchdown speed, close to the limits for the code, and the deceleration to taxi speed required two corrections to hold the centerline. Marginal performance for the Training Section - a touchdown point closer to 1000 feet and tighter centerline control are expected to improve in the following sorties.

SP directed the A/C to the RWY centerline, executed the round out in time and assumed the landing attitude accurately and promptly. Touchdown was achieved 850 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 3 feet of the centerline and 2 knots above the computed touchdown speed, with no float, balloon or bounce. Deceleration to taxi speed was carried out by the standard procedure, without abrupt oscillations, and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the landing with exceptional precision, with the gradual power reduction and the round out timed so that the landing attitude was assumed at the correct height on every attempt. Touchdown was achieved 780 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and 1 knot above the computed touchdown speed. The crosswind controls were held into the roll-out with no drift at touchdown and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP without any deviation. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, due to an incorrect visual aiming point in the final stage of the approach, did not begin the round out at the height required to level off the A/C and assume the landing attitude, and the A/C touched down flat and bounced. SP did not react to the bounce as described in the Flight Manuals, with the result that the IP took the controls and executed the go-around. Touchdown had occurred 1700 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 19 feet right of the centerline and 12 knots above the computed touchdown speed.

SP, due to inadequate monitoring of airspeed during the approach, did not start the gradual reduction to power at the correct point and carried excess energy into the round out, so the A/C floated. The float was recognized and corrected only after the IP's verbal indication. Touchdown was achieved at the limits for the code, 1500 feet from the beginning of the RWY and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed, with the lateral displacement reaching 15 feet from the centerline.

SP, due to a slightly late round out, did not assume the landing attitude before the A/C reached the touchdown point, and touchdown occurred 1350 feet from the beginning of the RWY at 7 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The lateral displacement reached 10 feet from the centerline during the roll-out. The errors were minor and were recognized and corrected by the SP in a timely manner, without the IP's intervention, and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP.

SP executed the landing accurately and promptly, directing the A/C to the RWY centerline and assuming the landing attitude in time for touchdown. Touchdown occurred 990 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 5 feet from the centerline and 5 knots above the computed touchdown speed, at the limits of the code on all three parameters. Marginal performance for the Training Section - a touchdown point nearer the aiming point and closer control of the touchdown speed are expected in the following sorties.

SP flew the landing with exceptional precision in a gusting crosswind, applying the crosswind controls from the beginning of the round out and holding the A/C on the RWY centerline throughout. Touchdown was achieved 820 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and with negligible deviation from the computed touchdown speed, on the upwind main wheel and with no drift. Deceleration to taxi speed was carried out by the standard procedure without oscillations and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the no-flap landing to the standard set for this Training Section, with the IP calling the power reduction and completing the round out from the rear cockpit. Touchdown occurred 2400 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 21 feet from the centerline and 14 knots above the computed touchdown speed, and the extended float was terminated by the IP. Marginal performance for the Training Section - independent recognition of the flatter no-flap landing attitude is expected to develop over the following sorties.

SP completed the no-flap landing without the IP directing or executing any part of the sequence, requiring only verbal indications to reduce power gradually and to hold the flatter landing attitude. Touchdown was achieved at 2000 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 15 feet from the centerline and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The float was recognized and corrected with delay, after the IP's verbal indication. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the round out in time for the no-flap configuration, assumed the landing attitude and brought the A/C to touchdown without any verbal prompting. Touchdown occurred 1800 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 8 feet from the centerline and 7 knots above the computed touchdown speed. The minor float was recognized by the SP and corrected in a timely manner without the IP's intervention, and the A/C was decelerated to taxi speed and vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP executed the no-flap landing accurately and promptly, reducing power gradually and assuming the flatter landing attitude required by the configuration. Touchdown was achieved 1350 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 4 feet of the centerline and 3 knots above the computed touchdown speed, with no float, balloon or bounce. The A/C was decelerated to taxi speed by the standard procedure without abrupt oscillations and vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP flew the no-flap landing with exceptional precision, controlling the higher approach energy so that the round out produced no float and the landing attitude was held to touchdown. Touchdown was achieved 1150 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and 1 knot above the computed touchdown speed. Deceleration to taxi speed was carried out by the standard procedure without oscillations and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP with no deviation. Above end of block MIF achieved.

The IP took the controls and completed the landing 2500 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 20 feet from the centerline and 13 knots above the computed touchdown speed.

Touchdown was achieved at the limits for the code, 2000 feet from the beginning of the RWY, 15 feet from the centerline and 10 knots above the computed touchdown speed.

Touchdown was achieved 750 feet from the beginning of the RWY, within 2 feet of the centerline and 1 knot above the computed touchdown speed, on the main wheels and with no drift. Deceleration to taxi speed was carried out without oscillations and the A/C vacated the RWY following the LAP. Above end of block MIF achieved.
